title: Two Young Girls at Outdoor Table, 1940s Backyard B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet mid-20th-century snapshot capturing two young girls, labeled 'Karen' and 'Lynn' on the top margin of the print, sitting together at a folding card table in a sunny backyard. The older girl has pigtails and holds a cup while looking inside it, while the younger child watches attentively next to an enamel pot. Set outside a rustic wood-shingle home beside a large weathered tree, the scene embodies innocent childhood domestic play and sibling camaraderie during the 1940s era.
